summary: Daytona's Startup Grid landing page advertises up to $100,000 in credits, but current pricing and the linked program terms state up to $50,000. The linked terms, last updated 5 June 2025, specify $10,000 upon acceptance and discretionary additional tranches up to $50,000 aggregate. The applicable cap and term version for new admissions remain unresolved; confirm with startupgrid@daytona.io rather than assuming either ceiling is guaranteed. Those linked terms describe privately held companies incorporated within five years, less than $15 million raised and fewer than 50 full-time equivalents at application. They require credit redemption within 12 months of issuance, internal business use only, and prohibit resale, sublicensing or third-party access using credits. Admission is discretionary, and no response time is guaranteed. The 12-month credit validity is not a campaign end date.
claim_steps: Open https://www.daytona.io/startups and read the linked Startup Grid terms, last updated 5 June 2025, before submitting an application.
Check the linked terms' eligibility: privately held company, incorporated no more than five years before application, less than $15 million raised, and fewer than 50 full-time equivalents.

Ask startupgrid@daytona.io which cap and term version apply to your application: the landing page advertises up to $100K, while pricing and linked terms state up to $50K aggregate. Additional tranches are discretionary, not guaranteed.

Complete the startup application form if eligible. Acceptance is discretionary; the linked terms describe rolling review and an endeavor to respond within ten business days, with no guaranteed response time.

If accepted, confirm the $10K initial credit and any additional tranches in writing and in your account. Under the linked terms, redeem credits within 12 months of issuance for internal business use only; do not resell, sublicense or provide third-party access using credits.

social_proof.title: Linked Startup Grid terms — last updated 5 June 2025; cap applicability unresolved
social_proof.text: Upon acceptance, each Participant receives USD 10,000 in Credits. Additional tranches up to an aggregate USD 50,000 may be granted at Daytona’s sole discretion based on milestones that Daytona communicates in writing.

social_proof.title: Linked 2025 terms — credit validity and permitted use
social_proof.text: Credits are applied to the Participant’s Daytona account upon acceptance and must be redeemed within twelve (12) months of issuance. Credits may be used solely for the Participant’s internal business purposes in accordance with Daytona’s Terms of Service, Acceptable Use Policy, and any applicable regional regulations.
